title: feat: announce community namespace and validate canonical key IDs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Announces the September 11 switch to community/username/model for community models and agents.
- Key create/update validates membership in the available canonical-ID set. No alias detection, lookup, normalization or silent filtering.
- Preserves empty restrictions and other permission fields. Generation aliases are unchanged; rename PR #14621 migrates stored permissions in D1.
- Focused key, migration and billing tests pass. No merge or deployment.

gist.headline: Community models get addresses
gist.blurb: Community models and agents are getting a proper garden path: community/username/model. API keys now check their model permissions against the canonical IDs, so the hive knows exactly which flowers are on the list.
gist.summary: Announced the September 11 move to canonical community/username/model IDs for community models and agents, while API key creation and updates now validate permissions against the available canonical-ID set without rewriting aliases or filtering empty restrictions.
gist.impact: Developers can prepare keys and integrations for the community/username/model namespace, with existing generation aliases unchanged and explicitly empty model restrictions preserved.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden directory represents the new canonical community/username/model addresses: labeled signposts lead to small code-plants owned by different gardeners. Polli, wearing a tiny postal cap, checks a key-shaped permission list against the clearly labeled garden registry, emphasizing exact IDs without changing the familiar existing paths.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny postal cap as she compares a key-shaped permission card with garden signposts reading “community / username / model”; code-plants and pixel flowers grow beside the paths, with a friendly CRT monitor robot holding the registry. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text “CANONICAL PATHS”, nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
